a.lede: The FBI is probably concerned about the implication of a Chinese agent having influence over the leader of the U.S.'s leading AI chip manufacturer.
a.title: President Trump says the FBI is investigating Jensen Huang’s affair

b.lede: U.S. intelligence sources suggest that Nvidia chief Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence in a 'honeypot' operation involving Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.
b.title: US intelligence believes Jensen Huang had affair with Chinese spy in honeypot operation
